name: Welcome to Krampus RPG
description: Choose your first Pokémon and begin your adventure.

name: A Strange Beginning
description: Quest Line 01 #1 — Speak with the village researcher and investigate reports of aggressive Pokémon near Frostpine Route.

name: Something in the Woods
description: Quest Line 01 #2 — Track the marked Pokémon into the pines and face the Krampus Scout watching the treeline.

name: Marked
description: Quest Line 01 #3 — Rescue a marked Pokémon from the Krampus Handlers' cages.

name: Stolen Pokémon
description: Quest Line 01 #4 — Free the caged Pokémon at the Team Krampus camp before the Handlers return.

name: The Winter Relic
description: Quest Line 01 #5 — Recover the Winter Relic from the old shrine before the Krampus Archaeologist does.

name: First Lieutenant
description: Quest Line 01 #6 — Battle Lieutenant Noelle, field commander of Team Krampus.

name: Missing Children
description: Quest Line 01 #7 — Follow the Krampus Keepers to find the missing festival children.

name: Blackout
description: Quest Line 01 #8 — Hollyhollow goes dark. Push the Krampus enforcers out of the plaza.

name: The Krampus Bell
description: Quest Line 01 #9 — Learn the truth about the Krampus Bell and what rings beneath the fortress.

name: Krampus Fortress
description: Quest Line 01 #10 — Fight your way through the fortress corridors to the Bell Chamber.

name: Truth Beneath the Mask
description: Quest Line 01 #11 — The Director's mask comes off. The conspiracy is bigger than one region.

name: The Bellringer
description: Quest Line 01 #12 — The final battle: Director Krampus and his six-Pokémon team beneath the Krampus Bell.
